title: CADi SAML Gold & Negative Training Dataset Schema
description: Formal JSON schema for fine-tuning LLMs on deterministic mechanical assemblies in CADi SAML v0.6.0.

id.description: Unique deterministic identifier for the training sample.

instruction.description: User design request or specification prompt in natural language.

input.description: Optional contextual input or initial assembly state.

output.description: Target response: executable CADI-SAML Python code or structured error diagnosis.

output_type.description: Type of output payload: executable CAD script or structured error diagnosis.

spec_completeness.description: Exact mathematical ratio: count(user-specified parameters) / count(total required dimensional parameters).

contract_verified.description: Whether the output was executed and passed post-build contract validation.

provenance_tracked.description: Whether all non-prompt parameters are tracked to authoritative DIN/ISO standards or calculated derivations.

source_standards.description: List of engineering standard references used in this sample (e.g. ['DIN 1025-1', 'ISO 7005-1']).

reasoning_summary.description: Compact, auditable mechanical engineering rationale explaining dimension derivation and standards selection.

input_parameters.description: Key-value map of dimensions and constraints explicitly parsed from the user prompt.

catalog_parameters.description: Key-value map of parameters retrieved from standard catalogs (DIN/ISO).

derived_parameters.description: Key-value map of mathematically or kinematically calculated parameters.

expected_error.description: Structured error specification for negative training samples.
